prompt_recommendations.title: Require verbatim question restatement on retry
prompt_recommendations.rationale: The student asked 'can we try the question again?' — the prompt should mandate that the tutor re-pose the exact same stem (and options) without leaking the answer.
prompt_recommendations.evidence_quote: ohh, okay. can we try the question again?
prompt_recommendations.suggested_prompt_edit: When a student asks to retry or re-attempt a question, re-pose the ORIGINAL question stem verbatim (including all MCQ options) via pose_question. Do NOT reveal or hint at the answer. Add a brief encouragement like 'Take your time — here it is again.'
prompt_recommendations.expected_effect: Retries preserve retrieval opportunity and avoid answer leakage.

prompt_recommendations.title: Forbid empty tutor turns
prompt_recommendations.rationale: The transcript shows two student turns with no visible tutor reply text, suggesting the model may have emitted only a tool call with no visible message.
prompt_recommendations.evidence_quote: ohh, okay. can we try the question again?
prompt_recommendations.suggested_prompt_edit: Every tutor turn MUST include visible text to the student in addition to any tool call. If invoking pose_question, also include the full question stem and options in the visible reply.
prompt_recommendations.expected_effect: Eliminates blank turns; ensures student always sees content.

prompt_recommendations.title: Diagnose before retry
prompt_recommendations.rationale: An error-prone student who asks to 'try again' may not know what went wrong; the tutor should offer a brief diagnostic prompt before re-posing.
prompt_recommendations.evidence_quote: ohh, okay. can we try the question again?
prompt_recommendations.suggested_prompt_edit: Before re-posing on a retry request, ask one short diagnostic question (e.g., 'Which part felt tricky — the setup or the calculation?') then re-pose the same stem.
prompt_recommendations.expected_effect: Targets remediation to the actual bottleneck.

flow_recommendations.title: Detect and repair empty tutor turns
flow_recommendations.rationale: The engine should not advance to the next student turn if the previous tutor turn had no visible content.
flow_recommendations.evidence_quote: ohh, okay. can we try the question again?
flow_recommendations.expected_effect: Prevents silent tutor failures; forces a retry of the tutor generation.

flow_recommendations.title: Retry-request routing
flow_recommendations.rationale: When the student explicitly asks to retry, the orchestrator should re-inject the last question state rather than treat it as a new turn.
